title: Deutsche Bank increases commitment to support Squadron Energy's renewable energy portfolio in Australia
summary: Deutsche Bank increases commitment to support Squadron Energy's renewable energy portfolio in Australia
body_markdown:
Deutsche Bank has committed 160 million Australian dollars as part of a refinancing for[Squadron Energy](https://squadronenergy.com/) covering five operating wind assets across Australia and one under construction.


Squadron Energy, the renewable energy platform of privately owned Australian investment group[Tattarang](https://www.tattarang.com/) , develops, owns and operates renewable energy assets across Australia. Its portfolio comprises approximately 2 GW of wind assets spanning New South Wales, Victoria and Queensland.


The refinancing provides Squadron Energy with flexible, non-recourse financing to support approximately 1.5 gigawatts of operational wind farms and Uungula Wind Farm, which is under construction in NSW. The flexible portfolio financing can also accommodate Squadron Energy’s future growth, including the optionality to expand into battery energy storage projects.


> Deutsche Bank’s commitment reflects our confidence in the operational strength of Squadron’s wind portfolio and its long-term growth strategy, both of which are expected to play an important role in Australia’s energy transition. We are pleased to deepen our partnership with Squadron and support the next phase of its growth. Michael Volkermann, Global Head of Project Finance at Deutsche Bank
